perks.name: Sharp Edges
perks.description: Throwing Knife final blows decrease the cooldown of your Super. Hitting a single target with most Blade Barrage knives in a volley causes them to release a violent Solar explosion; releasing scorching Solar shrapnel. Hits and final blows with Blade Barrage will return Super energy after the Super ends.

archetype.name: Powerhouse
archetype.description:
Armor configured for Guardians that take the word "impossible" as a challenge.

Primary Stat: Weapons
Secondary Stat: Super

item.name: +Weapons / -Health
item.description: Increases this armor's Tuned stat at the cost of a small amount of the Health stat.

item.name: Heavy Handed
item.description: Your powered melee final blows create Orbs of Power.
item.exact:
On Powered Melee Kill:
Spawns an Orb of Power.

Orb of Power:
0.8% | 1.1% | 1.25% | 1.5% Super Energy.

Incurs a 10 | 5 | 1 second cooldown between Orbs.
Can trigger alongside Firepower if equipped after it.
From left to right order.

item.name: Harmonic Loader
item.description: Increases reload speed of Arc weapons.
item.exact:
To Mod-Element Matching Weapon, after ~0.5 second of readying the weapon:

+10 | +15 | +18 Reload Speed
0.85x Reload Duration Multiplier

item.name: Impact Induction
item.description: Causing damage with a powered melee attack reduces your grenade cooldown.
item.exact:
Upon dealing Powered Melee Damage:
Grants Grenade Ability Energy.

Ability Energy Gain:
12% | 17% | 20%
6% | 8.5% | 10%

Incurs a 7 second cooldown after activation.
